title: feat: add Floret model overrides
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds optional per-capability `routing` overrides to Floret’s OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for text, web search, image generation, image editing, video, and audio. Omitted fields or `auto` preserve Floret’s automatic routing.
- Validates explicit model IDs against the caller-visible Pollinations model catalog before agent execution, returning stable errors for unknown, incompatible, or temporarily unavailable selections.
- Threads immutable routing preferences through the agent and tool loop. Explicit user choices override agent-selected models, while existing streaming, mixed-media responses, and automatic behavior remain intact.
- Hardens the hosted authentication boundary: users call `gen.pollinations.ai` with their `pk_`/`sk_`; the gateway mints a short-lived internal `ag_` token for Floret. Hosted Floret rejects direct user keys, while the existing local-development operator-key fallback remains available.
- Adds focused routing, API, agent, media-tool, and live regression coverage. The complete Floret suite passed locally (110 tests), and PR CI is green.

## Release status

Backend implementation only. This PR does **not** register Floret in the public model catalog or deploy it. Community-endpoint registration with delegated generation enabled and deployment are still required before Floret should be announced as publicly available.

gist.headline: Floret gets a routing dial
gist.blurb: Floret can now keep a caller’s model choices pinned while it works through text, search, images, video, and audio. The flower has more knobs; it is still waiting behind the garden gate.
gist.summary: Floret’s OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint now accepts optional per-capability routing overrides for text, web search, image generation and editing, video, and audio, validates selected models against the caller-visible catalog, and carries immutable preferences through its agent and tool loop.
gist.impact: When Floret is registered and deployed, callers will be able to choose compatible models per capability or leave fields as auto, while hosted requests use short-lived internal ag_ tokens instead of passing pk_/sk_ keys directly to Floret.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-workshop control panel represents Floret’s per-capability routing: separate labeled sprouts for text, search, images, video, and audio each connect to a small model-selection dial. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener-toolbelt, carefully sets the dials while a friendly flower-shaped terminal keeps the chosen paths neatly threaded through vines; a small locked gateway token symbolizes the hosted authentication boundary.
